integrity: Theorem is supported by an explicit transfer, integer edge potentials, constructive endpoint attainment, and analytic root expansions; finite checker is supporting diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations: The exact graph is a two-row periodic strip with one oriented diagonal per rung gap; no two-dimensional phase transition is inferred. A more general published ladder independence-domination polynomial could cover some formulas.
title: Exact crystalline endpoints and fractional-density laws on a triangular maximal hard-core strip
